Predy is a decentralized derivatives protocol on public blockchains that offers leveraged derivative positions built on smart contracts. Predy operates without intermediaries and is part of the DeFi domain.

Primitive is a decentralized options protocol on the Ethereum blockchain that uses smart contracts to settle option contracts. Primitive operates without intermediaries and is part of the DeFi domain.

Element is a decentralized fixed-rate yield protocol on public blockchains that splits yield-bearing assets into principal and yield tokens. Element operates through smart contracts without intermediaries and is part of the DeFi domain.

Floor is a decentralized NFT liquidity protocol on public blockchains that enables exposure to NFT collection floor prices through smart contracts. Floor operates without intermediaries and is part of the DeFi domain.

Squeeth is a decentralized power perpetual protocol on the Ethereum blockchain, created by Opyn, that provides exposure to squared ETH price movements through the oSQTH token. Squeeth operates through smart contracts without intermediaries and is part of the DeFi domain.
